Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. N.K.Agrawal Sr. Adv  Mr. Danish Raja, Adv  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Bharat Bhushan, APP  For the Informant Mr. Dharmendra Kumar, Adv

CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint.
Case No. 1536 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 468 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. As per the complaint petition, the complainant runs Ayurvedie Medicare & Development organization at Motihari, which works for welfare of the society and provides education, training and medical assistance to economically weaker class of minority children of residential Madarasa.

The complainant Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.48684 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 claims that all the accused persons along with present petitioner have cheated him and fraudulently grabbed Rs.
5,08,00,845 by creating forged documents on the pretext that they runs permanent Madarasa.
4. Learned senior counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and due to oblique and ulterior motive, he has been implicated in this case.
There is no specific allegation of transaction of money and not a single money was paid by the complainant to the petitioner.
The complainant has not stated in S.A about any specific transaction made in favour of the petitioner.

sentences.text: 5. Learned APP for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, and also taking into consideration the materials available on record, the petitioner above named, in the event of his arrest/ surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of this order, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Judicial Magistrate, Sadar, Motihari, East Champaran in connection with Complaint.Case No. 1536 of 2022, subject to condition as laid Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.48684 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 down under Section 482(2) of the BNSS, and further condition is that one of the bailors should be close relative of the petitioner.
